notes.title: ROBOBEAT - ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
Hello everyone, Simon here,
Hope you all are doing well! 

I'm super excited to announce my next game; ROBOBEAT!

Description
Rouge-lite, fast-paced. Stuck in an ever-changing mansion created by an insane showman. To escape, you have to captivate the audience. Feel the beat.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1456760/ROBOBEAT/

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019375/66d9b9344e9c0ae4768e609ddfcc777248f26547.png

Release
I'm aiming to release the game at the end of this year.
Sometime before then, I will open the BETA. You can sign up on the steam page if you want. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/31019375/5dc534de4cbe7311432266eeb805464ae2b45038.png

I know it's quite far away from Break the Game in terms of genre and gameplay.
But I know some of you will like It!

If you got any questions about anything, please message me on twitter: @FredholmSimon

notes.title: _PATCH_01 + _02 + _03
notes.content:
Added some new things based on feedback.

_PATCH_2019_07_16:

- Multiple controller support (will change automatically)
- Fixed bug that made it impossible to get rid of splash screens / Press B screen.
- Added photosensitivity options (disable different glitch effects in Settings->Graphics)
- Fast forward enabling moved to Settings->Gameplay
- Made Kay more stronk
- Spelling errors and a few minor bugs.

_PATCH_2019_07_17:
- Controller Dead Zone slider
- Balance changes
- Added small secret
- Various minor bug fixes

_PATCH_2019_07_21:
 - Reset Savedata will no longer remove Purple Achievement Collection progress.
 - Fixes issues related to ending
 - Fixed two soft-locks (Teamwork & Calm)
 - Various minor issues & bugs + Jeremy

Thanks for everything! (:
